images.view: Cinematic panoramic landscape seen from a low rocky ridge close to the colony, with the horizon in the upper half of the frame and plain bare rocky ground filling the lower third of the frame.
images.subject: In the middle distance, on top of a towering sea cliff, stands a cluster of far-future high-tech installations with domes and towers, spanning about a third of the frame width, their windows and floodlights glowing brightly.
images.detail: The colony and the sky above it share the frame, both large and clearly visible. The colony is thriving: a few small spaceships fly above it and vehicles move along a bright road leading to it.
images.site: Beyond the ridge, towering dark neutral grey rock cliffs heavily covered with thick white snow and ice plunge straight into a vast frozen sea of cracked pale ice with ice floes and pressure ridges, which stretches to the horizon, on a frozen lifeless alien planet of bare rock, ice and wind-blown snow.
images.light: Art direction: realistic sci-fi concept art, hopeful and optimistic mood, bright golden-hour sunlight with rich warm tones on the rock, crisp clear air with good contrast, a deep clear blue-teal sky, the colony gleaming white and sunlit.
